Re-extracted 2 fps frames from all 14 clips and diffed them against the third-pass frames: only shot-2 changed (YAVG 2.25); shot-1 differs by 0.09 with no pixel above the 24/255 threshold (encoder noise); all other shots 0.00. Re-measured audio (ebur128 I=-20.4 LUFS, LRA 17.7 LU, true peak -2.0 dBFS; decoded-PCM MD5 identical to passes two and three). Entries for unchanged shots and criteria are carried forward from the third pass. Sound measured only, not auditioned by ear.
